ui_bugs.issue: Primary action buttons inside modals (ÜRET in licenses.tsx:154, EKLE in permissions.tsx:161) have no testID. This forced the E2E test to use text=/role selectors, which are brittle: Playwright get_by_role('button', name='ÜRET') timed out because the underlying Pressable does not expose role='button' in RN Web output. Had to fall back to JS-clicking the parent element. Add testIDs (e.g. ADMIN.licGenerateSave, ADMIN.mvSave) to make E2E robust — same pattern already used for admin-ann-save.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Add testIDs to the primary action Pressable in the LicenseGenerate modal (licenses.tsx:154, e.g. testID='admin-license-generate-save') and the New Visibility modal (permissions.tsx:161, e.g. testID='admin-mv-save'). This mirrors admin-ann-save and eliminates the need for text/JS fallbacks in E2E.
critical_code_review_comments: announcements.tsx:62 correctly filters is_active !== false. Consider surfacing 'Pasif' rows behind an admin toggle in the future if hard-delete is not desired.

permissions.tsx save() also does a self-mapping check (managerId === employeeId). Backend still returns 400 'Hedef kullanıcı müdür değil' if the target is neither manager nor admin — good, but a translated inline hint before submit would prevent a round-trip.

rca of the issue: Iteration 118 announcements delete bug root cause: backend soft-deletes announcements (sets is_active=false) but GET /api/announcements returns ALL rows. Fix in announcements.tsx:62 filters `a.is_active !== false` after each load; delete now removes the row from view immediately and after reload. Iteration 118 permissions silent-duplicate root cause: form did not do a client-side check before POSTing an existing (manager,employee) pair. Fix in permissions.tsx:77-80 iterates existing rows and sets formError 'Bu eşleşme zaten tanımlı' before calling the API — verified with the seeded mgr_test→emp1_test mapping.
